verses.11:70: فَلَمَّا رَءَآ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيۡهِ نَكِرَهُمۡ وَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةࣰۚ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِ لُوطࣲ‏
verses.51:28: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةࣰۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمࣲ‏

en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
meaning: The root وَجَسَ (wajasa) denotes sensing something faintly and listening for it. Ibn Fāris gives it as إحساس بشيء وتسمع له — a perception followed by straining to hear; whence توجّس, to feel a stirring of fear within.
meaning_source: Derived from the classical dictionaries (chiefly Maqayis al-Lugha, Ibn Faris d.1004) held in lexicon_full/
